title: curie cluster access-policy --json
description: The agent-facing payload of `curie cluster access-policy <agent>`: the dry-run plan, or the agent's access policy as the API stored it (ADR 0220). `invocation_team_id` and `approver_team_id` are null when that role names no team and keeps today's behavior. `version` is 0 when the agent has no policy. `changed` is false for a show (no team flag) and true when this invocation wrote. Nothing enforces the policy yet.

invocation_team_id.description: The IdP group team whose members may start a turn with the agent, or null when none is set.

approver_team_id.description: The IdP group team whose members may resolve the agent's approvals, or null when none is set.
